v1.4.1 Update
- The Manager now renders up to 20 Actor cards at a time in worlds with many Actors.
- Searching and paging the Actor list keeps unsaved editor text in place.
- Actor and organization changes avoid a second Tracker refresh when the Manager is also open.

announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.4.1
announcement.content:
Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.4.1 improves the Manager in worlds with many Actors.

  • The Actor list renders up to 20 cards at a time. Searching and paging leave unsaved editor text in place.
  • When the Manager and Tracker are both open, Actor and organization updates avoid a second Tracker refresh.
